Lina: heads-up: backfill backfill-03-t9 has been RUNNING 4h but aggregates unchanged. Customer flagged billing jump.
Omar: which failure mode? quota or data error?
Lina: ops logs show repeated `heartbeat_only=true` with `kv_schema_mismatch` occasionally.
Kai: can we emit a compact enum label `job_wait_signal` (QUOTA|KV_SCHEMA|SHARD_LOCK|OTHER) + `job_wait_since`? cheap and actionable.
Omar: +1. Also add `tokens_effective_processed` so billing can exclude heartbeat ticks.
OpsBot: suggested alert: job.state==RUNNING && job_wait_signal!=null && job_wait_since>10m -> notify #eng-platform-oncall (PD).
console-team: minimal UI: show a small "wait reason" pill in job list and deep link to job details. Prototype 48h.
billing-bot: will ignore metrics tagged `heartbeat_only=true` once new metric present. Please follow naming: `billing/processed_tokens`.
Lina: decision: Omar to add labels (ETA 3h), console-team to wire pill (ETA 2d), ops to add alert (today). Omar, ping when deploy queued.
Omar: noted. I'll land a tiny runtime tag and a curl example for operator override after deploy.
console-team: thanks — will wire the pill to read `job_wait_signal` only (no ETA yet).
